description.zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID。
description.en: The Group ID of the consumer to query.

description.zh: 需查询的 Group ID 所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填。
description.en: The instance ID that corresponds to the Group ID to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces.

description.zh: 重置位点到指定的时间戳，仅在 Type 为 1 时生效。单位：毫秒。
description.en: The timestamp to which the consumer offset is reset. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to 1. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 需重置位点的 Topic 名称。
description.en: The name of the topic for which you want to reset the consumer offset.

description.zh:
消息清理类型，取值说明如下：
- 0：清除所有消息。
- 1：清理到指定时间。
description.en:
The message cleanup type. Valid values:
- 0: clears all messages.
- 1: clears messages up to a specified time.
